title.zh: Polymarket将就荷兰禁令提起诉讼
title.en: Polymarket将就荷兰禁令提起诉讼

current_state.zh: Polymarket is filing a lawsuit against the Dutch regulator Ksa's order barring it from operating in the Netherlands, arguing its product should instead be supervised by financial markets authority AFM.
